statement: EXACT INTEGER FORM + ITERATION. With N(x)=#{A029902<=x}, the self-similarity is the exact integer relation N(x)+N(floor(b x)) = 2x + e(x), e(x) in {-1,0,1} (no floating point; x/a + bx/a = 2x exactly since 1/a+1/b=1... correction: x/a+bx/a = x(1+b)/a = 2x). Iterating the cocycle gives the formal solution D(x) = sum_{k>=0} (-1)^k e(floor(b^k x)) (plus a vanishing tail), so boundedness of D is EQUIVALENT to boundedness of these alternating base-b digit sums.
